scientific_integrity: Two separate exhaustive standard-library implementations reproduce the same exact state and adjacency counts; statements of external publication priority and independent review are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification for the Petersen graph and the minimal four-colour palette only; it does not imply any theorem for other cubic graphs, larger palettes or Kempe-chain recolouring. The total of 49,920 proper colourings was known before this work; the contribution is the reachability-component and symmetry classification. Publication overlap in unindexed sources remains possible.
title: Optimal edge-colouring recolouring on the Petersen graph: two large components and frozen configurations
